questions.question: A CMDB Administrator has built a number of Technology Management Service Offerings (Technical Service Offerings) based on Dynamic CI Groups to better maintain group alignment for the member CI.Which Groups are synced to CIs from the offering that has a relationship to a Dynamic CI Group? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Set Support group, Change group or Managed by group on a Technology Management Offering linked to a Dynamic CI Group and the values are applied to all its CIs. Approval, CMDB and Owned by groups are not synced. (Change group is also synced.) Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/common-service-data-model-csdm/csdm-enable-tso.html

questions.question: The CMDB Administrator has set up two Dynamic Reconciliation Rules within the ServiceNow Production Instance. The 'Server' class has a Dynamic Reconciliation Rule of largest value for the RAM field. The 'Windows Server' class has a Dynamic Reconciliation Rule of most reported for the RAM field. The following RAM values are reported in CMDB 360/Multisource CMDB: Altiris = 4.096 MB, SCCM = 4.096 MB, ServiceNow = 8.192 MB, Tivoli = 2.048 MB. Which value would be added to the CMDB for RAM for a 'Server' CI?
questions.explanation: A plain Server CI uses the Server class rule (largest value), so it gets 8.192 MB. The Windows Server rule (most reported, which would give 4.096 MB) only applies to Windows Server CIs - child-class rules override the parent only for that child class. (Data table reconstructed: the original image was missing.) Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/r_ReconciliationRulesPrinciples.html

questions.question: A CMDB Administrator would like to minimize stale CIs in the CMDB.Which CMDB Health Dashboard scorecard displays this information?
questions.explanation: Duplicate, Orphan and Stale CIs are the Correctness metrics. Completeness covers required and recommended fields, and Compliance covers audits against certification templates. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/r_CMDBHealthMetrics.html

questions.question: A manufacturing organization has implemented Incident Management in ServiceNow and wants to integrate additional products to enhance its functionality. Drag each ServiceNow product to the value it brings to supporting Incident Management. Some options may not apply.
questions.explanation: Reconstructed (original drag-and-drop content was missing). Discovery keeps CI data current, Service Mapping provides service impact, Event Management binds alerts to CIs and creates incidents. Cloud Provisioning and Governance doesn't directly support Incident Management. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/it-operations-management/event-management/ci-binding-alert.html

targets.label: Keeps infrastructure CIs and their relationships accurate so incidents reference the correct CI
Shows which application services depend on a failing CI so the business impact of an incident can be assessed
Binds monitoring alerts to CIs, correlates them and can open incidents automatically

questions.question: In a company there is a need to understand the CSDM maturity level needed. Different stakeholders listed a number of use cases that they expect over time.Which use case requires information objects?

choices.text: The Event Operations team wants to automate their events into incident for operational actions.
The Business Service Management team wants to understand the operational impact for their consumer parties.
The Customer Service team wants to onboard pro-active case management.
The SecOps team wants to understand the operational risk in the Business Application context.
The Asset Management wants to understand to asset life cycle compliancy in a Business Application context.

questions.explanation: Understanding operational risk in a business-application context (which apps hold sensitive data) requires Information Objects related to Business Applications. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/common-service-data-model-csdm/design-domain.html

questions.question: Drag and drop the application service type to the best description.
questions.explanation: Top-down (pattern-based) mapping gives a high-fidelity map for mission-critical services; tag-based mapping fits cloud, container and VM environments using cloud tags; ML connection suggestions use fingerprinting for custom-built apps; Dynamic CI groups fit small services defined by a CMDB query. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/application-services.html

targets.label: Recommended for mission-critical application services that require a precise approach using patterns
Best fit to map cloud-native, container-based, or virtual machine environments
Ideal for custom-built applications and leverages fingerprinting to generate service maps in a timely manner
Ideal for small application services that can be easily defined using filters and CMDB queries

questions.question: A CMDB Administrator needs to import external data into the CMDB. As the CMDB Administrator wants to reduce the risk for creating duplicates and to update information from unauthorized sources, it has to be ensured that the Identification and Reconciliation API will not be bypassed.What is the recommended method to import data into the CMDB utilizing the Identification and Reconciliation API?

choices.text: Table API (REST API or SOAP API)

questions.explanation: IRE processing is built into IntegrationHub ETL, so all data is automatically identified and reconciled. The Table API and plain Import Sets/transform maps bypass the IRE unless you add extra scripting. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/integration-hub-etl/integrationhub-etl.html

questions.question: Drag and drop the CMDB Health Dashboard metric to the description.
questions.explanation: Each CMDB Health Dashboard metric has a specific meaning related to data quality.

targets.label: CMDB records that represent the same physical or logical asset multiple times
Fields necessary to create or update a CI record in the CMDB
CMDB records that no longer maintain their logical or physical relationships with other CIs
CMDB records that are no longer actively updated, but remain stored in the database
Fields that support the accuracy, completeness, and usability of CI records in the CMDB
Actual values of specified fields are compared to the expected values defined in a template

questions.question: Where can a CMDB 360/Multisource CMDB Saved Query be viewed and created in the CMDB Workspace?

choices.text: Saved queries window on the Insight tab
Coverage window on the CMDB 360 tab
Saved queries window on the CMDB 360 tab

questions.explanation: The Saved queries card on the CMDB 360 tab of CMDB Workspace lists your CMDB 360 queries; from there you can run and edit them or create new ones. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/cmdb360-exp-cmdb-workspace.html

questions.question: A Platform Owner is collaborating with stakeholders in the manufacturing industry to align their CIs with the CSDM 5 framework. They need to map production line monitoring systems to the appropriate CSDM domain.Which CSDM 5 domain does the Platform Owner use?
questions.explanation: Deployed operational systems such as production-line monitoring are Service Delivery (Manage Technical Services) CIs. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/common-service-data-model-csdm/manage-tech-servs-domain.html

questions.question: A new custom class is needed to reflect a new application being managed in the CMDB.Which roles are minimally needed to add this custom CI class?
questions.explanation: Creating a class creates a table (a dictionary change), so you need sn_cmdb_admin (or itil_admin) plus personalize_dictionary. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/t_CreateCIType.html

questions.question: A Configuration Manager has configured a multiple data sources which are all authorized to update the same class and the same set of class attributes in the CMDB.What can the Configuration Manager do to control which data source should be authoritative source of truth for a specific class of set of class attributes?

choices.text: Assign a priority to each data source in the reconciliation rules
Manually run the data source updates in the correct order
Configure data refresh rules with a specific time period
Assign a run order to each data source in the identification rules

questions.explanation: When several discovery sources are authorized for the same class attributes, reconciliation rules assign each source a priority (smaller number = higher priority) to decide which one is authoritative. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/create-reconciliation-rule.html

questions.question: An organization is changing data centers and needs to know the consequences of the planned changes.How can Application Service mapping be used as part of Change Management?

choices.text: To understand the physical location of CIs
To identify which devices will go offline first
To understand the business impact of CIs

questions.explanation: Service maps show at a glance which application services a planned change affects, i.e. the business impact. CI location is just an attribute and doesn't need mapping. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/it-service-management/change-management/itsm-change-use-case-product-view.html

questions.question: A development team is working on a project and an application will be deployed to many servers. There will be several security requirements that must be checked to adhere to lawful compliance because the application will be holding customer personal data (PII and PCI).Where in the CSDM does the development team look to store the information that will be used to satisfy the audits?

choices.text: Technology Management Service Offerings (Technical Service Offerings) and Dynamic CI Groups

questions.explanation: Regulated data (PII, PCI DSS, HIPAA...) is modeled as Information Objects related to the Business Application (Business application Uses::Used by Information object) in the Design & Planning domain. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/common-service-data-model-csdm/design-domain.html

questions.question: What is the relationship between an application and a server?
questions.explanation: Relationship names are read from the parent's side: the Application (parent) 'Runs on' the Server (child) and the Server 'Runs' the Application, i.e. Application > Runs on::Runs > Server. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/common-service-data-model-csdm/manage-tech-servs-domain.html

questions.question: When CMDB 360/Multisource CMDB is enabled, Dynamic Reconciliation Rules become available. Based on a request from management, a CMDB Administrator has to set up multiple Dynamic Reconciliation Rules. Which are available 'Dynamic Rule Types' within the 'Create Reconciliation Rule' wizard? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Dynamic rule types include First Reported, Last Reported, Most Reported, Largest Value and Smallest Value. 'Last Updated' and 'Last Created' are not rule types. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/create-reconciliation-rule.html

questions.question: A CMDB Administrator identifies duplicate CIs. One was created by a manual import, and the other one was created by automated discovery. The discovered CI has the latest IP address, while the manually imported CI has an accurate relationship to a critical business application.How does the Administrator use the Duplicate CI Remediator to resolve this issue?

choices.text: Retain the manually imported CI, and delete the discovered CI
Merge the two CIs automatically, retaining all attributes from the discovered CI
Retain the discovered CI, but merge the relationship from the manually imported CI
Retain the discovered CI, and delete the manually imported CI

questions.explanation: Pick the discovered CI (newest discovered) as the main CI in the Duplicate CI Remediator. 'Use Main CI' keeps the main CI's attribute values and merges relationships and related items from the duplicate. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/reconcile-dup-task.html

questions.question: Where can an administrator perform Natural Language Queries (NLQ)?
questions.explanation: CMDB Workspace's search and explore view supports Natural Language Query (NLQ) through Intelligent Search for CMDB. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/sg-workspace-search-explore-view.html

questions.question: A customer’s CMDB is aligned to the CSDM Walk stage.What benefit is provided by the CMDB?

choices.text: Enables impact assessments for incident, problem, and change on Business Services
Improves the implementation velocity of APM Foundation for future business application rationalization
Allows for additional stratification of Technical team’s support structure along the lines of OLAs and commitments

questions.explanation: Walk-stage value includes 'additional stratification of the technical teams' support structure along the lines of OLAs and commitments'. Business-service impact assessment is a Run benefit and faster EA/APM adoption is a Crawl benefit. Source: CSDM 5 white paper (ServiceNow); https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/common-service-data-model-csdm/csdm-implement-walk-stage.html

questions.question: User endpoint devices are imported into the CMDB and populate the ‘Assigned to’ [assigned_to] field on the Computer [cmdb_ci_computer] CI. The Asset team puts in a request for the Configuration Analysts to populate the ‘Assigned to’ field on the related Asset.What action does a Configuration Analyst take to achieve this in an automated way?

choices.text: Use the Asset-CI Field Mapping module to create a new rule to replicate the ‘Assigned to’ value between the asset and associated CI
Hide the ‘Assigned to’ field on the asset record and create a new field that dot walks to the related CI to get the ‘Assigned to’ value
Configure a business rule on the computer table to use a script to populate the ‘Assigned to’ filed on the asset based on insert or update in the computer class ‘Assigned to’ field

questions.explanation: Asset-CI Field Mapping (Asset > Administration > Asset-CI Field Mapping) is the supported, no-code way to keep a field synchronized both ways between an asset and its CI. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/it-asset-management/asset-management/t_CreateAssetandCIFieldsMapping.html

questions.question: The following identification rule for a CI class has been defined: Identification rule (Hardware): Serial Number (serial_number, serial_number_type) priority 100; Hardware (serial_number) priority 200; Hardware (name) priority 300; Network Adapter (mac_address, name) priority 400. Two new CI records are imported into the hardware class of the CMDB: CI1: The name of this CI record matches the name of an existing CI record in the CMDB. CI2: The IP address of this CI record matches the IP address of an existing CI record in the CMDB. Which is correct based on the identification rule and the imported CI records?

choices.text: CI1 will be inserted as new record and CI2 will be updated with matching record.
CI1 will be updated with matching record and CI2 will be inserted as new record.
CI1 and CI2 both will be updated with matching records.
CI1 and CI2 both will be inserted as new records.

questions.explanation: CI1 matches an existing CI on Name, which is an identifier entry, so it is updated. IP address is not a criterion attribute in the rule, so CI2 matches nothing and is inserted as a new CI. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/class-hardware.html

questions.question: A CMDB Administrator wants to remove all Linux Servers in the organization that have not been updated in six months.Which recommended action does the Administrator take in Data Manager?
questions.explanation: This is the docs' own Archive example: 'Archive all Linux servers in the Seattle datacenter that haven't been updated for six months'. Archive removes CIs from the active tables and still allows restore during the retention period. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/cmdb-data-management.html

questions.question: A healthcare provider faces a critical incident affecting its patient management system. The provider needs to determine the users impacted to mitigate disruption effectively.Which CSDM-related data should they leverage?

choices.text: Service Offerings by Department or Location

questions.explanation: Business service offerings identify subscribers by user, company, location, department and group ('Subscribe by'), which tells you which users are impacted. Affected CIs list CIs, not users. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/common-service-data-model-csdm/csdm-implement-run-stage.html

questions.question: A CMDB Administrator needs to create a new CI class for the Internet of Things (IoT) Sensor in ServiceNow.What are the recommended practices for this specific activity? (Choose two.)

choices.text: Add a new class under an appropriate parent class
Install or update the CMDB CI Class Models store application, and verify the class does not already exist
Delete an unused class, and replace it with the new one

questions.explanation: First install/update the CMDB CI Class Models Store app, which adds many ready-made classes (IoT Device already exists). If no suitable class exists, extend an appropriate parent class in CI Class Manager. Don't repurpose, modify or delete base classes, or extend Asset tables for CI data. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/cmdb-ci-class-models/cmdb-ci-class-models.html

questions.question: A customer wants recently imported server records to be automatically reclassified into more specific CMDB classes after being discovered using ServiceNow Discovery.During the discovery process, if existing Server [cmdb_ci_server] records are reclassified into the Linux [cmdb_ci_linux_server] and Windows Server [cmdb_ci_win_server] classes, which reclassification operation occurred?
questions.explanation: Server -> Windows Server (or Linux Server) is parent -> child, so it is a Class Upgrade. Child -> parent is a Downgrade, and moving between sibling branches (e.g. Linux Server -> Windows Server) is a Switch (a downgrade followed by an upgrade). Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/t_ManuallyReclassifyCI.html

questions.question: The CMDB Administrator group aims to display meaningful results on the CMDB Health Dashboard Compliance Scorecard for server records that are not on the latest patch.What must be configured to achieve this goal?

choices.text: Certification Policies, Data Filters, Scheduled Jobs
Technical Service Offerings, Dynamic CI Groups, CMDB Groups

questions.explanation: The Compliance scorecard is driven by audits: a certification filter selects the servers, a certification template defines expected values (e.g. latest patch), and the audit compares actual values. Audit must be active for Compliance to show results. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/r_CMDBHealthMetrics.html

questions.question: A Configuration Manager wants to use the Unified Map.Where would it be accessed?
questions.explanation: Unified Map is included in CMDB Workspace (and Service Graph Workspace). Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/unified-map/cmdb-workspace-unified-map.html

questions.question: A CMDB Administrator wants to improve data quality related to the CSDM.Which action should the Administrator take to meet this goal?

choices.text: Use the default configured CMDB Health Dashboard
Use the CSDM Data Foundation Dashboard

questions.explanation: The CSDM Data Foundations dashboard shows key CSDM indicators per implementation stage (Foundation, Crawl, Walk, Run, Fly) and links to playbooks for remediation. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/csdm-data-foundations-dashboard.html

questions.question: A Change Manager aims to streamline ITSM processes by automatically populating fields on the Change form when a CI is selected. The Configuration Management team is working to ensure that the Change Group field is populated for all managed CIs. As a result, which base system field on the change form will be automatically populated after selecting a CI?
questions.explanation: Selecting a CI fills the task's Assignment group from the CI's Support group (incident) or Change group (change); 'Change group' was previously labeled 'Assignment group' on the CI. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/common-service-data-model-csdm/csdm-data-synchronize.html

questions.question: A Platform Data Owner wants to improve data quality with a few reconciliation rules across the five discovery sources that are being used. The Data Owner knows the best option is to include CMDB 360/Multisource CMDB to manage and monitor discovery sources, but the company currently does not have a license for ITOM Discovery that is required for CMDB 360/Multisource CMDB.What can the Data Owner do in this case?

choices.text: ITOM Discovery needs to be purchased to take advantage of the multisource IRE Rules.
CMBD 360/Multisource is a platform product that can be used immediately.
The IRE reconciliation rules can use discovery source regardless of CMDB 360 being enabled.

questions.explanation: Static reconciliation rules (source priorities) are core IRE functionality and work without CMDB 360. Only CMDB 360 itself (and its dynamic rules) needs the ITOM Discovery license plugin. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/multisource-cmdb.html

questions.question: A CMDB Administrator has been tasked with gathering information for a presentation to leadership. The Administrator needs to provide Duplicate CI, Orphan CI, and Stale CI metrics.Which scorecard provides this information on the CMDB Health Dashboard?
questions.explanation: Duplicate, Orphan and Stale CIs are the Correctness metrics. Completeness covers required and recommended fields, and Compliance covers audits against certification templates. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/r_CMDBHealthMetrics.html

questions.question: A service owner is using Unified Map to understand to composition of a service but wants to filter out irrelevant information.Which options are available to the service owner from the filter panel? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: The Unified Map filter panel filters by layer count, CI class, relationship type, discovery source, location and CI ownership. Business criticality is not a filter option. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/unified-map/unified-map-configure-filters.html

questions.question: According to the Common Service Data Model (CSDM), a server team is requesting a catalog item be created for infrastructure upgrade requests.Which role is involved in initiating the request and defining requirements?
questions.explanation: Infrastructure services are owned by Technology Service Owners, who request catalog items for their offerings and define the requirements. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/common-service-data-model-csdm/csdm-content-frame-exploring.html

questions.question: A Data Center Manager is working with the CMDB CI Class Manager to define the relationship between Application Servers and the Applications they host. The company has multiple Application Servers that host one or more Applications.Which describes the relationship between the Application Server table ([cmdb_ci_app_server]) and the Application table ([cmdb_ci_appl])?
questions.explanation: One application server hosts many application CIs, while each discovered application CI is tied to a single host, so the relationship is one-to-many. (Debated question: the CMDB relationship table could technically store many-to-many.) Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/common-service-data-model-csdm/manage-tech-servs-domain.html

questions.question: Which ServiceNow solutions create relationships between CIs automatically? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Discovery creates relationships from the TCP connections it finds, and Service Mapping builds the map of CIs and connections in an application service. IntegrationHub ETL only creates relationships you explicitly map, and Workflow Studio doesn't populate the CMDB. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/it-operations-management/discovery/r_ApplicationDependencyMapping.html

questions.question: What is the difference between Data Certification and Attestation policies when managing a CI?

choices.text: Attestation requires correcting specific attributes of a CI, while Data Certification tracks acknowledgement the CI still exists.
Attestation can be scheduled, while Data Certification cannot be scheduled.
Attestation tracks acknowledgement the CI still exists, while Data Certification requires validating specific attributes of a CI.
Attestation can be assigned to a Group or an individual, while Data Certification can only be assigned to an individual.

questions.explanation: Attestation records acknowledgement that a CI still exists; Certification validates specific attribute values. Both policy types can be scheduled and both support the same assignment types (user, group, user field, group field). Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/cmdb-data-management.html

questions.question: A CMDB Administrator wants to create a CMDB query to find all databases located in Seattle that are connected to application services. They also want to include incidents related to those databases.Which actions does the company take to build this query? (Choose two.)

choices.text: Add to the canvas the Incident table from the Non-CMDB Tables list
Add a filter to the database node for location=Seattle
Set the relationship level to ‘Up to 2nd level relationships’
Add property columns to the application service node

questions.explanation: In the CMDB query, add Incident from the Non-CMDB Tables list and add a location=Seattle filter on the database node. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/use-cmdb-query-builder.html

questions.question: A CMDB Administrator is evaluating whether to monitor the metrics provided on the CMDB Foundation Dashboard.Which benefits support the decision to continually monitor the results on this dashboard? (Choose two.)

choices.text: Provides a list of all CIs that failed health audits
Provides metrics for CIs Processed by the IRE
Provides metrics on active CIs updated in the last 90 days
Reports on all orphan CIs in the CMDB

questions.explanation: The CMDB Data Foundations dashboard's Data Management Practices metrics include 'CIs Processed via IRE' and 'Active CIs Updated in Last 90 days'. Failed audits and orphan CIs are CMDB Health Dashboard metrics. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/cmdb-data-foundations-dashboard.html

questions.question: A CMDB Administrator needs to identify which attributes have been created specifically for the Windows Server class.Which tab in the Attributes section is used?
questions.explanation: The Added tab lists attributes defined on this class itself; Derived lists attributes inherited from parent classes; All shows both. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/t_ViewTableDefinitions.html

questions.question: The Apache Web Server Identification Rule is configured with the following Criterion attributes:Class -Configuration file -Version -Yesterday, an Apache Web Server CI was discovered as part of Service Mapping. Today, the application owner upgraded Apache to a different version and reran discovery of the service.What will happen in the CMDB?

choices.text: The existing Apache Web Server CI will be reconciled and its version will be updated.
The Apache Web Server CI will be reclassified as a Web Server CI.
A new Apache Web Server CI is created.

questions.explanation: Version is one of the criterion attributes. After the upgrade the version no longer matches, so no identifier entry matches and the IRE creates a new Apache Web Server CI (if all rules are exhausted without a match, a new CI is created). Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/t_CreateCIIdentificationRule.html

questions.question: A CMDB Administrator is reviewing the health of the CMDB and notices a large percentage of the Hardware CIs are missing serial numbers. The Administrator is concerned this may cause duplicate CIs and would like to resolve the issue in a timely manner.What structured guidelines provided by ServiceNow are available to troubleshoot and resolve the issue?
questions.explanation: 'Hardware CIs with Serial Numbers' is a CMDB Data Foundations dashboard metric, linked to the playbook 'Manage Hardware CIs with missing Serial Numbers'. The CMDB Health Dashboard has remediation tasks, not playbooks. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/cmdb-data-foundations-dashboard.html

questions.question: The Configuration Manager is preparing the justification to utilize the CMDB Data Foundations Dashboard.Which benefits align with the usage of this dashboard? (Choose two.)

choices.text: It enables monitoring and tracking of CMDB health over time.
It provides actionable insights to improve data quality and completeness.
It helps detect and eliminate duplicate records in the CMDB.
It automates the approval process for change management.

questions.explanation: The dashboard trends non-compliant CIs over time and gives actionable insight (with playbooks) to improve data quality. It doesn't remove duplicates itself or approve changes. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/cmdb-data-foundations-dashboard.html

questions.question: An Asset Manager wants to ensure that Asset records and CI records are kept synchronized automatically.How does the Manager do this? (Choose two.)

choices.text: Ensure one-to-one physical mapping between Asset and CI
Ensure that scheduled jobs are run during off-business hours to ensure sync happens
Ensure that the business rule to update Asset fields on change on the CI table is active
Ensure that the business rule to update CI fields on change on the asset table is active

questions.explanation: Asset and CI records stay synchronized through two base-system business rules: 'Update CI fields on change' on alm_asset and 'Update Asset fields on change' on cmdb_ci. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/it-asset-management/asset-management/c_ManagingAssets.html

questions.question: Configuration Management needs to ensure data quality for all CIs in the CMDB.What areas of data quality for CIs are in the CMDB Health Dashboard? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Duplicate, Orphan and Stale CIs are the Correctness metrics. Completeness covers required and recommended fields, and Compliance covers audits against certification templates. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/r_CMDBHealthMetrics.html

questions.question: A Change Manager wants to gain value from CSDM.How will the Change Management process benefit from CSDM? (Choose two.)

choices.text: Identify blackout windows for the change
Determine the root cause of the change issue
Understand the impact of the change on services

questions.explanation: A service-aware CMDB lets Change understand the impact of a change on services and offerings, and route changes dynamically using the CI's change group. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/it-service-management/change-management/itsm-change-use-case-example.html

questions.question: The CMDB Configuration Management team has successfully developed a healthy and trusted CMDB. They have integrated discovered infrastructure data, accurately referenced non-discoverable data (such as change and support group information), and made the CMDB service-aware using Service Mapping.Which field on an Incident form is automatically populated after a CI is selected that references an appropriate support group?
questions.explanation: Selecting a CI fills the task's Assignment group from the CI's Support group (incident) or Change group (change); 'Change group' was previously labeled 'Assignment group' on the CI. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/common-service-data-model-csdm/csdm-data-synchronize.html

questions.question: An organization needs to maintain non-discoverable attributes, such as warranty expiration dates, for hardware CIs. These attributes are not updated by automated discovery tools.What method ensures these attributes are accurately maintained for all CIs?

choices.text: Create a new CI class specifically for non-discoverable attributes
Use the CMDB Reconciliation Engine to update the attributes
Use a scheduled data import to update the attributes from an external source

questions.explanation: Data that discovery can't see should come from its authoritative source through a scheduled import. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/c_OptionsToPopulateCMDB.html

questions.question: A CMDB Configuration Manager is reviewing the metrics on the CMDB Health Dashboard’s Correctness Scorecard for the Server class which consists of a total of 60,000 servers in the CMDB.For the Duplicate metric, it shows Healthy CIs/Evaluated as 59,000/60,000.For the Orphan metric, it shows Healthy CIs/Evaluated as 45,000/50,000.Which configuration explains the difference in the scope of Server CIs (60,000 vs.50,000) evaluated between the two metrics?

choices.text: The Duplicate metric has a CMDB Group configured for the Server class.
The Duplicate metric has a Health Inclusion rule configured for the Server class.
The Orphan metric has a Health Inclusion rule configured for the Server class.
The Orphan metric has a CMDB Group configured for the Server class.

questions.explanation: Health inclusion rules have an 'Applies to metric' field, so one metric (here Orphan) can evaluate fewer Server CIs than another. A Health-type CMDB group scopes a whole dashboard view, not a single metric. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/create-health-inclusion-rule.html

questions.question: Which are business values of CMDB? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: The CMDB streamlines incident and change management with impact and dependency data and strengthens operational resilience. Financial data belongs to Asset Management. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/cnfig-mgmt-and-cmdb.html

questions.question: A Configuration Management Process Owner is preparing solution options for presentation to the technical governance board for ingesting custom CIs to the CMDB. The solution needs to align with best practice, minimize the cost of future work (technical debt) and ensure compliance with future upgrades.Which solutions accomplish this? (Choose two.)

choices.text: Repurposing a base CI class and rename attributes, as required
Extending an existing CI class table to accommodate the custom CI class attributes
Installing or upgrading the ‘CMDB CI Class Models’ store application to find a suitable existing CI class accommodating any new attributes
Extending an existing Asset class table to accommodate the custom CI class attributes

questions.explanation: First install/update the CMDB CI Class Models Store app, which adds many ready-made classes (IoT Device already exists). If no suitable class exists, extend an appropriate parent class in CI Class Manager. Don't repurpose, modify or delete base classes, or extend Asset tables for CI data. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/cmdb-ci-class-models/cmdb-ci-class-models.html
